admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/audit/triage.py, src/rh_pipeline/cli/check_upstream.py and pyproject.toml, guarded by six unit tests in tests/unit/test_check_upstream.py, and prevents mutating pinned upstream checkouts or missing mapped/audit drift between leaves.

applicability: Read-only upstream freshness triage in src/rh_pipeline/audit/triage.py, CLI wiring in src/rh_pipeline/cli/check_upstream.py and console-script registration in pyproject.toml.
conditions: Never executes git fetch, git pull, git checkout or writes to upstream/replay checkouts or audit/; rejects blank or hyphen-prefixed refs to prevent Git option injection.

Classifies primary upstream ancestry into up-to-date (exit 0), unmapped-only (exit 0), mapped-drift (exit 10, using --no-renames so renamed tracked/mapped files stay visible), history-switched (exit 11) and invalid input/schema errors (exit 2), emitting timestamp-free sorted-key JSON with --json.
Evaluates optional --replay checkouts informationally (not-checked, not-pinned, up-to-date, moved, history-switched) without altering the primary upstream exit code.
exclusions: Passing --replay-ref without --replay is ignored; non-UTF-8 upstream path bytes propagate UnicodeDecodeError outside TriageInputError; argparse usage errors follow standard exit code 2 behavior.

statement: The read-only pre-leaf upstream freshness triage module and rh-check-upstream CLI classify upstream commits into up-to-date (exit 0), unmapped-only (exit 0), mapped-drift (exit 10), history-switched (exit 11), and input/schema errors (exit 2), emit deterministic sorted-key JSON with --json, and report informational replay_status without mutating any checkout.
title: Read-only pre-leaf upstream freshness triage CLI (rh-check-upstream)
